source.title: Parallel Communicating Grammar Systems with Bounded Resources: Results, Techniques, Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 1502103 and source name 1502103.

Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/1502103 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. The zbMATH REST API record for identifier 1502103 succeeded and identified the exact work as Erzsebet Csuhaj-Varju, Parallel Communicating Grammar Systems with Bounded Resources: Results, Techniques, Open Problems, Journal of Automata, Languages and Combinatorics 5(3), 175-190 (2000), with no full-text links.

Exact-work recovery used DOI 10.25596/JALC-2000-175 from DBLP/OpenAlex. The DOI resolved to https://jalc.de/issues/2000/issue_5_3/jalc-2000-175-190.php, which only exposes bibliographic data, an abstract PDF, and a fulltext link requiring a personal account.

The JALC fulltext endpoint https://jalc.de/issues/2000/issue_5_3/fulltext/pp-175-190.pdf returned HTTP 401 Basic authentication. The accessible abstract PDF was rejected because abstracts are not adequate technical source text for extraction.

Repository recovery inspected the SZTAKI record http://eprints.sztaki.hu/2480/, which matches the exact title and pages but states that full text is not available from the repository. DBLP and the JALC volume index were metadata-only. The 2002 ScienceDirect/Theoretical Computer Science item found during exact-title search was rejected as a different work because it has a different title, coauthor, venue, pages, and DOI.
No document map was created because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article's problem statements was recovered.
No open-question candidates were extracted because the workflow did not use resolver metadata, bibliographic landing pages, abstracts, search snippets, or related works as technical evidence.
Source adequacy failed with failure modes blocked_or_challenged for the zbMATH page, metadata_only for the resolver and bibliographic pages, and paywalled_or_restricted for the JALC fulltext PDF.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1502103.json and outputs/latest.json.
